errors.evidence: The x-axis is not labeled. "Tokenizer" is the title of the legend.
The y-axis range shown in the plot is from 40.0 to 42.0, not starting at 40.5.
The starting value for the blue line (universal tokenizer) at 100k is approximately 40.45%, not 40.6%. This is a significant overestimation given the narrow y-axis scale.
The blue line increases from its starting point (approx. 40.45%) to the value at 175k (approx. 41.15%); it does not decrease.
The orange line increases from approximately 41.6% at 100k to approximately 41.75% at 175k; it does not decline. The value at 175k is not 41.4%.
The orange line decreases from its value at 175k (approx. 41.75%) to approximately 41.4% at 250k; it does not increase. The value is also incorrect.
The description fails to mention the legend, which is necessary to identify which line corresponds to the 'universal' tokenizer and which to the 'cluster' tokenizer.
